title: dupatya plumosa
intro: Dupatya plumosa, commonly known as the "Palmate-leaved Dupatya," is a plant species belonging to the family Rutaceae, native to Southeast Asia. The health benefits of Dupatya plumosa include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to treat various ailments such as skin infections, wounds, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce fever, and alleviate pain, making it a valuable natural remedy in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Dupatya plumosa include limonoids, flavonoids, and coumarins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
